subject: latent variable construct-where is the standard deviation to be estimated.

messages.author: 664ac7b343dc1ce6
messages.subject: latent variable construct-where is the standard deviation to be estimated.
parts:
This is the first time for me to try lavvan. thanks for this useful package. I don't understand some parts of this package. apologies if I say something wrong.

In the Structural equations of SEM: LV= B*s+E  E~(0,e)
LV are latent variables
B are parameters that need to be estimated.
s are social demographical variables
E are terms with mean zero and standard deviation to be estimated. 

When use lavaan:
require (lavaan)
SEM_NML <- "
Pro_Car =~ q1a+q1b+q1c+q1d
Env_Con =~ q2a+q2b+q2c+q2d
Pro_Car~~0*Env_Con

Pro_Car ~ AGE+GENDER+INCOME
Env_Con ~ AGE+GENDER+INCOME
"
I don't see the E part in the equation. And the calculation speed is so fast, It looks like there are no halton draws process.

Look forward to your reply.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: latent variable construct-where is the standard deviation to be estimated.
parts: I don't see the E part in the equation

Every variable has a disturbance term.  Residuals are thus referred to by the name of its associated variable.  For example, the residual variance of q1a is specified as:

q1a ~~ q1a  


You can automatically free all (residual) variances using the option auto.var=TRUE, which is already turned on by default in the sem() and cfa() wrappers around the basic lavaan() function.

Thanks a lot for your reply!

Actually, I am very confused about the E part recently. I am curious about how the "disturbance terms"  or we can also call it "random components" are estimated in Lavaan. 

Because there is another package called Apollo which can also be used to estimate hybrid choice model. The structural equation is written as :
Pro_Car ~ AGE+GENDER+INCOME + E in Apollo.  E is a term with mean zero and standard deviation to be calculated. the algorithm is based on a simulated method which needs halton draws. The estimation time of Apollo needs about 2 hours. While Lavaan only needs less than 1 minute. So I am curious about how Lavvan is so fast when the "disturbance terms" are involved. 

Please help me point out if I said something wrong. Thanks again for your help
